subject: Balance payment failed – {booking_ref}
preheader: Please pay the balance of {balance} using the secure link.
heading: The balance payment did not go through
body_html:
{guest_first_name}, we tried to charge the balance of {balance} for booking {booking_ref} to your card, but the bank declined the payment or asked for additional confirmation.

Your booking is still valid. Please pay the balance on our secure payment page – with the same or another card:

{cta_button}

If the button does not work, open this link (valid for 7 days): {payment_link}

{booking_summary}

If you need help, call us on {business_phone} or reply to this email.

Kind regards,
{business_name}
